methodology.all_required: one only when every required evidence span is in top 20

confidence.fusion: RRF divided by its theoretical maximum; bounded to [0,1]

methodology.mrr: reciprocal rank of first relevant evidence span through rank 10
methodology.ndcg: graded gain with log2 discount normalized by ideal ranking through rank 10
methodology.phase_peak_rss: process peak RSS is run-level; per-phase peaks are unavailable
methodology.recall: fraction of all known relevant candidates retrieved
methodology.resource_unavailable: unavailable measurements use JSON null plus measurement_status
methodology.retrieval_order: independent BM25 and dense generation, RRF, then all frozen-prefix rerank depths
methodology.unavailable_metrics: empty-denominator rates are represented as JSON null and excluded from macro means
